summary: Session 15 — Tested new JWT admin auth (POST /api/auth/admin/login, GET /api/auth/me, 5-attempt IP+email lockout), the chatbot context feed (GET /api/chat/context + /api/chat/context.md), Bearer-JWT impersonation, and the pre-existing parser regression (image OCR + multi-doc). Backend: 11/11 new pytest tests pass. The 2 previously-failing parser tests (TestAdminImageParse::test_image_upload_is_ocrd, TestAdminBulkDocumentParse::test_parse_multiple_documents) now also PASS. Frontend: end-to-end auth UI works — bad password shows 'Invalid email or password' toast and no JWT stored; good login stores a 3-part JWT in localStorage['rn-admin-jwt'], sets rn-role='admin', closes dialog, shows 'Signed in as admin' toast; JWT + role SURVIVE a hard page reload (regression from iter14 fixed); SPA-nav to /admin works; clicking [data-testid=impersonate-org-blackrod-town-council] now correctly lands on /organisation-dashboard with the impersonation banner visible (the iter14 redirect race bug is FIXED).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is very large (3700+ lines). Consider splitting auth, chat context, admin, and org route groups into modules under /app/backend/routers/.

backend_test.py hard-fails at import if REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL isn't in os.environ (KeyError on collection). test_session15_auth_chat.py falls back to reading /app/frontend/.env — recommend applying the same pattern to backend_test.py to make the whole suite robust when pytest is launched without env exports.
Admin.jsx is still ~2200 lines (flagged in iter14). Extracting QuickAddContentCard / BroadcastCard / TriageQueue would help maintainability.
login_attempts collection has no TTL index visible — brute-force records will accumulate. Consider a MongoDB TTL index on createdAt (expireAfterSeconds=900) so the lockout window auto-purges.

success_rate.frontend: 100% — auth login/logout/reload persistence/impersonation all verified end-to-end

test_credentials: admin@blackrodnow.co.uk / BlackrodAdmin!2026 (verified). Legacy launch code Blackr0dN0w!& still accepted per /app/memory/test_credentials.md.
seed_data_creation: login_attempts collection is cleared before and after the lockout test to avoid locking out subsequent runs.

Iter14's impersonation redirect race is fixed (verified URL lands on /organisation-dashboard after clicking impersonate). If lockout test locks the admin out on future runs, clear via: mongo --eval 'db.login_attempts.deleteMany({})' on test_database (test file already does this in a module-scoped fixture).
